name: Bogdan Rzońca - Considérant AC - Am 27
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: AC. whereas the Ombudsman conducted an inquiry in the context of the increase in illegal migration flows crossing the Mediterranean Sea and the disproportionate burden placed on the most affected EU regions; whereas the absence of effective border control and insufficient action against smuggling networks contribute to illegal migration flows and create a pull effect towards the EU’s borders;
